column1: # Zscaler, Inc. — Adjusted EBITDA Bridge & Normalized Add-backs
# Source: SEC EDGAR — XBRL companyfacts (10-K, as reported) + cited 10-K text. USD unless noted.
Add: Depreciation & amortization (per cash flow statement)
Add: Amortization of acquired intangible assets
# EBITDA = reported operating income + depreciation & amortization + amortization of acquired intangible assets (all D&A added back).
# Adjusted EBITDA adds the standard SaaS normalizations: stock-based compensation (the non-cash item driving the GAAP operating loss) and non-recurring restructuring charges.

# Restructuring is management's proposed non-recurring add-back; a QoE review should test whether it recurs. Amortization of deferred contract acquisition costs (commissions) is NOT added back — it is a normal operating cost.

# Figures are as-reported 10-K values (USD); the D&A line is transcribed from the cash flow statement. One-time classifications are illustrative for the diligence demo, not company-reported non-GAAP measures.
